summary: Independent document review of docs/design/components.json (SHA-256 6bd2b962952e96862ea43cc36763066d1fd1a610af3cbe552eed7fa98cd64740) and docs/design/system.md (SHA-256 b2cfd553a61ce6ad0b13fa77129d6898fbfe0d64e1bcc9cb4f69eb316931e0e5) against docs/runs/component-polish/plan.md (SHA-256 160bd3fc63e7f0314b3f5e2ee815244c709227d97e51290ce363c33f98b964db) found the Input geometry and feedback precedence, navigation composition, ToolCall disclosure versus result navigation, and PermissionRequest Button/action mapping coherent. The inventory is exactly 44 variants, including 18 Button variants; this document review cannot establish byte-equivalence to the previously accepted Button source without a recorded pre-change fingerprint. One material shared-badge composition decision remains implicit before Figma work. The 44px PermissionRequest target is a renderer requirement, not proven by these documents or Figma geometry. No rendered Figma, browser, device, runtime interaction, or assistive-technology evidence was reviewed.

open_findings.location: componentContracts.StatusBadge.sharedBy and ToolCall/PermissionRequest status fields (approximately lines 961-1339 and 1413-1423)
open_findings.affected_consumer: ToolCall and PermissionRequest Figma status indicators; AC-2 shared badge geometry
open_findings.evidence: StatusBadge defines 24px text-hug geometry and lists ToolCall and PermissionRequest as consumers, but neither consuming family declares a nested StatusBadge component reference or a state/label mapping. Both retain independent statusBackground/statusForeground bindings, so a Figma implementation can satisfy those fields with separate fixed-size status frames and recreate the inconsistency this run is meant to remove.
open_findings.correction: Add an explicit StatusBadge child/reference contract for ToolCall and PermissionRequest, with each parent state's badge semantic state and visible label or override. State that nested instances use StatusBadge's 24px, rendered-text-plus-16px geometry and token binding; keep the 44 canonical variants unchanged. Reconcile the same rule in system.md if needed.
